w: Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha of a Hari-mandir in Kadi and then addressed the assembly.
At 7.00 pm, Swamishri departed from Singapore and throughout the flight read Satsang literature.
At 9.55 pm (IST) Swamishri landed in New Delhi and was welcomed by senior sadhus and dignitaries.

Intro From 1977 Swamishri has inspired satsang in the tribal villages on the eastern strip of Vadodara district. Through Swamishri's and sadhus' travelings 35,000 tribal people have adopted satsang in their lives. More than 200 Satsang centers, youth centers, children's centers and women's centers are active in the region. The tribal devotees have built 5 hari mandirs and 25 sanskar centers. A BAPS medical van tours 102 villages providing free treatment to the tribal people. A modern hospital, "Pramukh Swami Hospital", in Dabhoi, caters to the tribal people. Tribal children are provided scholarships to encourage education. In times of drought or calamity the BAPS has distributed food grains, clothes and organized cattle camps. To solve the issue of drinkable water the Sanstha has undertaken watershed projects in the villages and towns of Sankheda, Pavi Jetpur and Kawant. On the occasion of 25 years of satsang activities in the tribal areas, Swamishri was invited to perform the bhumi-pujan ceremony of a large mandir with an educational complex, health center and anti-addiction center.
At 10.00 p.m. Swamishri performed the bhumi-pujan rituals and arti. Thereafter a satsang assembly was held. After Swamishri's blessings Shri Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by the tribal devotees.
From 5.00 p.m. Pujya Viveksagar Swami addressed the convention. The tribal youths performed an impressive tribal dance. In conclusion Swamishri blessed the convention.

Brahmatirth Swami, Ghanshyamprasad Swami and other sadhus of the kitchen department gave full details of the arrangements for this year's Fuldol festival. At the end Brahmatirth Swami said, "This time everyone present at the festival is to be given Swaminarayan khichdi and buttermilk. We will use only the dal and rice that come from you."
Swamishri said, "Nothing comes from us. Everything comes from the devotees. Understand that it comes by Maharaj's grace."
Narayancharan Swami said, "This organisation is yours, the devotees are yours too, so surely it can be said to come from you!"
Swamishri said, "That is true, but it is the organisation of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj, and by their grace and resolve the devotees give to us."

st.t: Myanmar President Win Myint Hails Swaminarayan Akshardham as a “Home to Rich Culture” on Visit to New Delhi
w: Myanmar President Win Myint and First Lady Daw Cho Cho visited Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi as part of an official state visit to India. The 28-member Myanmar delegation also included the Union Minister for International Cooperation Mr. U Kyaw Tin, Union Minister for Religious Affairs and Culture Mr. Thura U Aung Ko, Union Minister for Transport and Communications Mr. U Thant Sin Maung, Chief Minister Rakhine State Mr. U Nyi Pu and Myanmar Ambassador to India Mr. Moe Kyaw Aung.
President Myint was traditionally greeted by Gnanmuni Swami on behalf of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj, the sixth spiritual leader of BAPS.
“I am delighted to pay a visit to the Swaminarayan Akshardham Temple, home to rich art and architecture that demonstrates the rich culture and traditions of Hinduism,” President Mynit said.
President Myint, along with the delegation offered their respects at the Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir and performed abhishek to share sentiments for world peace and harmony.

The Myanmar delegation then viewed the Gajendra Pithika (Elephant Plinth) that features 148 lifelike carved stone elephants depicting messages of social harmony, peace, and spirituality. They also experienced the Sanskruti Vihar boat ride exhibition that displays 10,000 years of India’s heritage and contributions to society.
